career_ladder.note: The Railway Protection Force (RPF) and Railway Protection Special Force (RPSF) operate under the Ministry of Railways as an armed security force protecting railway property, passenger areas, and trains across India. Personnel in executive cadres advance from field patrol and station policing to post command (Inspector) and Group 'A' Gazetted managerial roles in the Indian Railway Protection Force Service (IRPFS).

exam_scheme.note: RPF recruitment for Sub-Inspectors (CEN RPF 01/2024) and Constables (CEN RPF 02/2024) is conducted in three stages: a Computer Based Test (CBT) of 120 marks, Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Measurement Test (PMT) (qualifying nature, 10-times vacancies shortlisted), and Document Verification (DV) along with Medical Examination in Railway Hospitals. The CBT features 120 questions across 3 subjects in 90 minutes with 1/3 (0.33) marks negative penalty.

financial_package.pay_source_label: Ministry of Railways — CEN RPF 01/2024 (SI Executive Pay Level 6)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 6 entry basic pay (₹35,400) for Sub-Inspectors with 58% DA (₹20,532), HRA (9%/18%/27%), Transport Allowance, and Ration Money Allowance (RMA, approx. ₹3,900/mo). For Constable (Executive) recruits at Level 3 (entry basic ₹21,700), monthly gross salary ranges from ₹38,000 to ₹49,000 with in-hand earnings between ₹33,000 and ₹43,000.
official_perks: All-India free Railway Privilege Passes and Privilege Ticket Orders (PTOs) for self and dependents
Free medical coverage in Indian Railway Hospitals and Health Units
Allotment of Railway residential quarters or House Rent Allowance (9%/18%/27%)
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Central Government matching contribution

competition_benchmarks.note: RPF recruitment attracts massive nation-wide participation. CEN RPF 01/2024 and 02/2024 announced 4,660 vacancies (452 Sub-Inspectors and 4,208 Constables). In the 2018 recruitment drive, over 59 lakh candidates registered for 9,739 advertised positions across RPF and RPSF.
